scope: How each original XXMI command class executes in the hosted runtime. The authority for execution support; scripts/check_ini_execution_matrix.py fails when a class of the pinned source has no entry, when a cpu decision disagrees with its probe, or when cited owned evidence is gone. Parsing coverage is docs/ini-language-coverage.md.

domains.cpu: A CPU generation: the original runtime without owned GPU adapters, shader hooks or a native extension. The character renderer in the game hosts Mod commands this way; the native Core boundaries its character extension adds are outside this matrix. Every cpu decision is probed by a fixture run through runtime_test.exe --probe-command.
domains.owned: The owned GPU domain of the sandbox: GpuShaderRuntime and GpuResourceRuntime installed into the same bridge. gpu decisions cite sandbox checks that exercise them; the other decisions take the same bridge path as cpu.

decisions.original: The original run() executes on this generation's state. No GPU work.
decisions.plan: Translated into a draw plan operation (binding, indexed draw, layout edit, skip) for the renderer.
decisions.gpu: Executed by an owned Vulkan adapter with DX11 semantics.
decisions.noop: Nothing happens, which is what the original does in a hosted generation.
decisions.removed: The original optimiser removes the command before any execution.
decisions.degraded: The command does nothing, the original's warning channel says so once, and the list goes on (D-137): what this domain cannot do as the original does.
decisions.refused: The generation or the draw refuses with a reason; nothing partial runs.
decisions.not-created: No construct in this domain creates the command.
